body.name: Broad fixed-known-J absorbing support model
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{face}}\) is the set of laws \(P\) satisfying \(\texttt{ass:consistency}\), \(\texttt{ass:no-anticipation}\), \(\texttt{ass:two-types}\), \(\texttt{ass:cohort-overlap}\), \(\texttt{ass:markov-paths}\), \(\texttt{ass:absorbing-exit}\), \(\texttt{ass:common-date-two-transition}\), \(\texttt{ass:common-first-post-untreated-transition}\), \(\texttt{ass:four-slice-rank}\), and \(\texttt{ass:simple-cycle-spectrum}\). Date-\(1\) absorption is allowed and no date-\(4\) common-kernel restriction is imposed.
